sources.text: Water your plants today and make sure they're getting enough light, Taurus. ac.text: Beauty can be found anywhere if you look for it. Connect with your surroundings throughout the day, darling Taurus, and notice how one setting differs from the next. As Mars and Uranus form a soft sextile, you'll feel energized by each vibrant landscape you occupy. Creative inspiration can also be gained when the Virgo Moon squares Uranus. However, this energy can make you vulnerable to impulsive spending you may later regret. Invest in your love life once Luna aspects Venus rx, or make plans to reconnect with friends you haven't seen in a while. Mercury activates this afternoon, encouraging you to see the world through a romantic lens.
